title: YOLOZU TrackingOutputInterface v1
description: Immutable tracker-free, session-scoped tracking output policy. Durable validation takes a validated StreamJobSpec, derives retained counts from an exact canonical StreamSummary, enforces its task, source, detector-result, 10000-mask, 10004-file, and 4-GiB ceilings independently, and binds both JSONL hashes through aggregate-only provenance plus exact checksums.json coverage. Person identification, face recognition, biometric inference, cross-camera or cross-session identity linking, and persistent identity databases are forbidden.

max_results_per_frame.description: Upstream-configured inclusive tracking-row cap for one processed frame; detector task-result accounting remains independent.
